g.text: Few bloc votes here, so the balance
Diamond: mean · whiskers: 95% confidence interval of the mean · box: middle half of localities, thin line: median

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 27px; font-family: 'Caladea'; text-anchor: start; fill: #1c1d21

g.text: Change in each locality's balance between the Netanyahu coalition and the opposition from the 2022 to the 2026 Knesset election,
grouped by how localities voted in 2022. A change of −0.10 means the gap between the two blocs moved 10 points toward the opposition.
Balance = (coalition − opposition) ÷ (coalition + opposition) votes; Arab-party and other votes are excluded. Groups use 2022 results only.
2022 coalition: Likud, Religious Zionism, Shas, UTJ. Opposition: Yesh Atid, National Unity, Yisrael Beiteinu, Labor, Meretz.
2026 coalition: Likud, Shas, UTJ, Otzma Yehudit, Religious Zionism, Noam. Opposition: Yashar, Beyachad, the Democrats, Yisrael Beiteinu. HaMiluimnikim & HaKalkalit and Amcha Yisrael are unclassified.
Sources: Central Elections Committee 2022 final results; CEC 2026 results by locality, all boxes counted (31 Oct 2026, not yet certified). n = 1,212 localities.
